about: Itch fx-audio packs (Lentikula spell/heal impacts, John Carroll warrior/mage/orc voices). Mono Ogg Vorbis 48 kHz, silence-trimmed, peak-normalised to -1 dBFS. 'volume' is a GainNode value that brings each file to about -18 dB active RMS. Group keys: '<category>' or '<category>:<kind>' (e.g. 'voice-orc-attack:heavy-attack').
